summary.text: Cory Robertson, a Libertarian Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House seat in Colorado's 3rd District to Jeff Hurd, receiving 1.7% of the vote to Hurd's 49.3% in unofficial results reported by NBC News.
The Libertarian Party of Colorado listed him as its candidate for the district; little other biographical information is publicly available.

sources.title: United States House of Representatives elections in Colorado, 2026
